of.needed: whether the environment has already explicitly configured tsdb schema and v13 schema versions

original.statement: Structured metadata is enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0 and requires tsdb storage backend and v13 schema configuration; Loki will not start without these.

decision.reason: [ev-5dacaee98643] says that in 3.0.0 structured metadata is on by default and Loki won't start unless the schema uses `tsdb` and `v13`. That means the exposed environments are those upgrading from before 3.0.0 whose schema is not tsdb/v13. The evidence doesn't name the config keys or schema paths that would show this, so treating schema state as undecidable is defensible and better than guessing a values path. The `needed` text names the right deciding fact: whether tsdb and v13 are already configured.
